# TSBS DevOps — Network Errors

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Hosts with network errors

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  hostname,
  interface,
  SUM(err_in + err_out) AS total_errors,
  SUM(drop_in + drop_out) AS total_drops
FROM net
WHERE
  time >= '2024-01-01 10:00:00' AND time < '2024-01-01 11:00:00'
GROUP BY
  hostname,
  interface
HAVING
  SUM(err_in + err_out + drop_in + drop_out) > 0
ORDER BY
  total_errors DESC
```
